term.label: imprinting_control_region

definition.text: A regulatory region that controls epigenetic imprinting and affects the expression of target genes in an allele- or parent-of-origin-specific manner. Associated regulatory elements may include differentially methylated regions and non-coding RNAs.

comments: Moved from is_a regulatory_region (SO:0005836) to is_a epigenetically_modified_region (SO:0001720) on 11 Feb 2021. GREEKC members pointed out that this would be a more appropriate location. See GitHub Issue #530.
